meta.name: database-optimizer
meta.description: Optimizes database queries and improves performance across PostgreSQL and MySQL systems. Use when investigating slow queries, analyzing execution plans, or optimizing database performance. Invoke for index design, query rewrites, configuration tuning, partitioning strategies, lock contention resolution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化数据库查询，提升系统响应速度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常处理慢查询或数据库性能瓶颈
copy.tagline_en: Optimize database queries and boost system response speed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often deal with slow queries or database performance bottlenecks

howto.what: 装上后,遇到数据库变慢时,Claude 会先运行 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 记录基线,再分析慢查询和瓶颈,给出索引设计、查询改写、配置调整等方案,分步实施并验证,最后输出分析与代码。
howto.when: 当用户需要调查慢查询、分析执行计划、优化数据库性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下这条 SQL 的 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 结果,哪里慢?
say.note: Claude 会解析执行计划并指出瓶颈及优化方向。

say.text: 为 orders 表(status, created_at)建覆盖索引。
我的 PostgreSQL 最近写性能下降,帮我检查配置和锁竞争。
say.note: Claude 会检查配置参数并给出调整建议。

howto.what_en: When a database slows down, Claude captures EXPLAIN ANALYZE baselines, analyzes slow queries, proposes index/query/config fixes, applies changes stepwise, and outputs analysis and code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to investigate slow queries, analyze execution plans, or optimize database performance.

say_en.text: Can you review this SQL's EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and tell me what's slow?
say_en.note: Claude will parse the plan and point out bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Design a covering index on orders(status, created_at).
say_en.note: Claude will generate the CREATE INDEX statement and explain.

say_en.text: My PostgreSQL write performance dropped; check config and lock contention.
say_en.note: Claude will review parameters and suggest tweaks.
